findings: Two .world-viewport canvas matches are expected: GameScene appends renderer.domElement plus a hidden tooltip canvas. Small-wrapper log selected battlefield. Therefore selector ambiguity is not established and is not grounds to relax visibility assertions.

Small-wrapper passed overlay-detached and Continue anyway pointer-target checks before canvas-visibility timeout; this supports recovery overlay precedence but does not establish successful usable battlefield at800x700.
Lifecycle wrapper did not reach restart, Continue, checkpoint or stale-atlas checks. These branches remain not-run within that attempted wrapper, not passes.
Art crash and screen readiness timeout do not contradict independently retained geometry/freeze/single-retry observations, but their root causes are not proved.
Production scene, store, loadRequest, retryLoad, start/cancel semantics are unchanged. Bounded presentation acceptance remains supported by exact-source independent live results.

recommendedTargetedDiagnostic.when: Only after full inventory releases the heavy lane; at most one new isolated episode, no broad unchanged rerun
recommendedTargetedDiagnostic.scenario: Fresh800x700 actual Home; original small-wrapper setup including All missions, fail first landscape request, Try again, then Continue anyway. Preserve existing assertion/readiness windows.
recommendedTargetedDiagnostic.capture: Before and after dismissal save screenshots plus every viewport canvas rect/computed display/visibility/ancestor layout/isConnected, active loading/desktop/dialog layers, current React-ref engine/store owner identity and started/disposed/inputMask state. Do not manually reveal canvas, swap ownership or change readiness.
recommendedTargetedDiagnostic.stop: Conclude once actual visible current battlefield is established or exact blocking state/timeout/crash is captured. A failed current-canvas observation is a real gap; do not change selector merely because two canvases exist.
recommendedTargetedDiagnostic.disposition: Parent chose not to run optional diagnostic absent concrete merge-blocking risk. Read-only review establishes no new loading-presentation defect; visibility cause remains unknown and broader lifecycle scope remains unverified.
